SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'page_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'page_view' THEN visitor_id END) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'page_view' THEN session_id END) AS session_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'duration' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duration_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'duration' THEN IFNULL(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props, '$.duration')) AS SIGNED), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_duration_ms FROM blog_event_log
GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT path, MAX(title) AS title, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS uv FROM blog_event_log WHERE event_type = 'page_view' AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY path ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(device, '未知') AS device, COUNT(*) AS count FROM blog_event_log WHERE event_type = 'page_view' AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY device ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT NULL AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count, 0 AS duration_count, 0 AS total_duration_ms FROM blog_event_log WHERE event_type = 'page_view' AND created_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'page_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'page_view' THEN visitor_id END) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'page_view' THEN session_id END) AS session_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'duration' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duration_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'duration' THEN IFNULL(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(props, '$.duration')) AS SIGNED), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_duration_ms FROM blog_event_log WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
